name: btn-hover-underline

frames.best_why: The underline is fully drawn under every word and the cursor sits below instead of covering the text.

tagline: Big white Contact me text; hovering draws a line under it.
summary: A large plain-text link that reads like a heading. When hovered, a thin line grows from left to right underneath the words, then retracts when the pointer leaves.
appearance: A large bold white Contact me sits on black, framed by a small wide-spaced caption above and a muted hint line below. The button itself is only the words, with a thin white underline appearing directly beneath them.
behaviour: Hovering sweeps a thin line from left to right under the text with an eased motion, and leaving pulls it back. The words themselves never move or change colour.
demo_content: Captions 'Have a project in mind?' and 'Hover to draw the underline' around a Contact me link.
search_phrases: line draws under text on hover
use_when: A contact or footer link should stay understated as plain text while still hinting that it is clickable.
avoid_when: With no border or fill, it can be mistaken for ordinary text when placed on a busy background.
customise: Only the words are editable in the markup; underline thickness, colour and easing are hardcoded classes, and it takes no props.
weight_why: One line of text and a CSS transform on a pseudo-element.

a11y.note: The visible words name the action and a native focus ring remains, but the underline appears on hover only, never on focus.

polish_why: Simple and clean, but it is large text with a hover underline and little else.
